Each query below is written from the page alone and has not been run. These are the points I was least sure of:
- `groupBy` with no key groups by the element itself, as in the page's `groupBy * count` law.
- `at 2` reads a vector element softly.
- `round` rounds to the nearest integer, so I scale by 10 or 100 and divide back for decimals.
- Map keys come back as keywords when grouped from strings.

M1: filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) | * (/email | lower) | sort
M2: * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | :xs / | sum | div (xs | count) | mul 10 | round | div 10
M3: * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country) | filter ~(type | eq ::string) | * upper | groupBy * count
M4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels | any ~(lower | eq "bug")) | sort ~([(/priority | mul -1) /id]) | take 2 * /id
M5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at :assignee | coalesce "unassigned") | groupBy * count
M6: * /labels | flat | * lower | distinct | sort
M7: /dependencies | :d / | keys * (:k / | {:name (k | keyword) :version (d | at k | if (startsWith "^") ~(drop 1) ~(if (startsWith "~") ~(drop 1) ~(/)))}) | sort ~/name
M8: filter ~(/status | [(eq "paid") (eq "shipped")] | any ~(/)) | * /items | flat | * (mul /qty /price) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
M9: filter ~(/status | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~/customer | * (* (/items | * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum) | :g / | keys * (:k / | {:customer (k | keyword) :total (g | at k | mul 100 | round | div 100)}) | sort ~([(/total | mul -1) /customer]) | take 2
M10: /services | filter ~(at :tls | coalesce {} | at :enabled | eq true) | :s / | keys * (:k / | s | at k | [/host (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join ":")
M11: lines * split " " | filter ~(at 1 | eq "ERROR") * (at 2) | groupBy * count
M12: lines * split " " | filter ~(at 1 | [(eq "WARN") (eq "ERROR")] | any ~(/)) | filter ~(drop 3 | join " " | lower | contains "timeout") * (at 2) | distinct | sort
M13: lines | drop 1 | * split "," | filter ~(count | eq 4) | filter ~(at 2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(at 1) | * (* (at 2 | parseJson) | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round)
M14: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog sleeps; the fox runs. A fox is quick." | split " " | * (lower | if (endsWith ".") ~(take (count | sub 1)) ~(if (endsWith ";") ~(take (count | sub 1)) ~(/))) | groupBy * count | :g / | keys * (:k / | {:word (k | keyword) :count (g | at k)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word]) | take 3
